text:
### Chargeback (Card Fraud)
**What It Covers:**
- Unauthorized card transactions: Dispute with card scheme
- Merchant error: Dispute with card scheme
- Item not received: Dispute with merchant/scheme  
**Timeline:**
- Report fraud within 120 days
- Bank investigates and disputes with merchant
- Refund if upheld (typically 3–6 months)
name: Chunk 44/61

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Card Transaction Chargeback
raw_entities.description: A fraud alert and chargeback process triggered when a customer reports an unauthorized card transaction. The bank disputes the transaction with the card scheme and investigates, with refund issued if the claim is upheld within a typical 3–6 month resolution window.
context: Unauthorized card transactions: Dispute with card scheme
Report fraud within 120 days
Bank investigates and disputes with merchant
Refund if upheld (typically 3–6 months)

raw_entities.name: Merchant Error Chargeback
raw_entities.description: A chargeback process initiated when a customer disputes a transaction due to merchant error. The bank disputes the transaction with the card scheme to resolve the discrepancy.
context: Merchant error: Dispute with card scheme
Bank investigates and disputes with merchant

raw_entities.name: Item Not Received Chargeback
raw_entities.description: A chargeback process for transactions where the customer reports that an item was not received. The bank disputes the transaction with both the merchant and card scheme to recover funds.
context: Item not received: Dispute with merchant/scheme
Bank investigates and disputes with merchant

raw_entities.name: Fraud Reporting Obligation
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance requirement for customers to report card fraud to the bank within 120 days of discovering the unauthorized transaction. Failure to report within this timeframe may affect the customer's eligibility for chargeback protection.
context: Report fraud within 120 days

raw_entities.name: Debit Card
raw_entities.description: A payment card subject to chargeback protection and fraud dispute procedures. The card is the instrument through which unauthorized transactions, merchant errors, and item-not-received disputes may occur.
context: Unauthorized card transactions: Dispute with card scheme
